s0.readme_text:
# SiD net S_0: training outputs

Research data, not a feed; never merge. Made by `training/sid-net-s0-20261113/chain.sh` on
`research/sid-net-s0-20261113` (source and settings in `logs/timeline.log`; steps 1 and 2 of `experiments/sid_loop/SPEC.md`).

- `runs/s0`: `policy.npz` (the epoch with the best held-out card log-loss), every epoch, `metrics.json`.
- `e1/`: the student against the exact solver on held-out boards (`scripts/sid_e1.py`).
- `labels/`, `labelsB/`: the label sidecars of the training episodes and of the held-out ones (`--full`), as tar parts
  of `<episode blob id>.npz`; `manifest.json` says what they were made with, `stats.jsonl` what each episode cost.
- `data/`: the fetch manifests (the training episodes are those at the tips of rollout net v2's last fetch) and label statistics.
- `logs/`: every stage.
s0.scope: Released research artifact; the notice explicitly says no bot uses it and no play occurred. It does not replace any canonical actor or model in this owned cohort.
s0.future_exclusions: For ANY later new owned cohort, retain the standing requirement to exclude all released-model training families, including S0's set. The notice says its training set matches rollout v2's; fetch.json is provenance, not a certified standalone family list. Obtain and validate complete pinned membership before any future preparation. Do not rewrite this current v4.1 cohort's immutable union or proof.

# Rollout loop outputs: azure6

**Work in progress. Research data, not an arena cohort and not a feed.** Outputs of the rollout loop's matches and
collections on azure6, run from branch `research/rollout-loop-20261113` (`runs.log` names each job's source commit):
match folders with one row a board, summaries and logs. Full records stay on the box. Never merge this branch.
azure6.scope: Research match/collection outputs, explicitly not an arena cohort or feed. Do not count them as registered arena observations, adopt their settings, or control their host.
